i18n_status.details: CRITICAL: All 6 locale files still claim '23 EU Languages' at key landing.features.languages (line 443). The landing_page.tsx actively renders this key via the features track list (line 25). Additionally, the description key 'languagesDesc' claims 'Full interface localisation across all official EU languages' which is false (only 6 languages supported). Yellow/Blue tier names are still exposed in non-EN locales (fr, ca, nl, es, it) at the consultations CTA section (lines 106-110). English locale uses plan names correctly but the 5 non-EN locales still reference 'Yellow' and 'Blue' levels.

predictions.details: Previous audit listed timeline and outcome as GET but current frontend code uses POST (axios.post at lines 298, 312). Backend also uses POST. Either the code was fixed since April 9 or the previous audit incorrectly reported the HTTP methods. Currently all 17 frontend prediction endpoints match the backend router definitions.

new_findings.issue: ACTIVE false claim: '23 EU Languages' displayed on landing page. The i18n key 'landing.features.languages' is rendered via landing_page.tsx line 25. CLAUDE.md explicitly prohibits claiming 23 languages. Should read '6 Languages' or similar. The description 'Full interface localisation across all official EU languages' is also false.
new_findings.fix: Change 'languages' value to '6 Languages' and 'languagesDesc' to 'Interface available in English, French, Dutch, Spanish, Catalan, and Italian' across all 6 locale files.

new_findings.issue: Internal tier names Yellow/Blue leaked to user-facing text in consultations CTA section (lines 106-110). CLAUDE.md says 'Never reference White/Yellow/Blue tiers. Use plan names.'
new_findings.fix: Replace 'Yellow' with 'Advocate' and 'Blue' with 'Professional' in all 5 non-EN locale files.

new_findings.issue: Uses raw fetch() instead of axios for API calls. Most other hooks use zustand+axios. The legal intelligence hooks use useState+useEffect+fetch, which works but is a different pattern from the rest of the codebase.
new_findings.fix: Optional -- works correctly. Could align with axios pattern if standardising.

new_findings.issue: New service follows the service-object pattern (like euCalendarService, consultationService) rather than the named-export-functions pattern (like prediction_service.ts). Both patterns coexist. Not a bug, but codebase has two API client patterns.
new_findings.fix: Pick one pattern for new services going forward.
